**Tamar Abakelia** was a Georgian artist born in 1905 in Khoni, western Georgia, which was part of the **Russian Empire** at the time.

The **Kingdom that acquired Thuringian territory in 1815** was **Prussia**, which gained significant portions of the Kingdom of Saxony (which included Thuringian lands) at the Congress of Vienna.

Now, regarding what dissolved the privileges in Poland of the Russian Empire: After the Partitions of Poland and the establishment of the Kingdom of Congress Poland (an autonomous polity within the Russian Empire) at the Congress of Vienna in 1815, its privileges were later revoked. On **February 26, 1832**, Emperor Nicholas I of Russia officially declared that Poles and Russians should henceforth be considered as one nation, effectively ending the autonomous status of Congress Poland and reorganizing it as just another province of the Russian Empire without its previously granted autonomy. This followed the failed November Uprising of 1830-1831.

**Answer: The privileges in Poland of the Russian Empire were dissolved in 1832.**
